title: Felt-Light Mornings v2
description: An intimate, felt-piano house cut in the fred again vein: chopped vocal/number fragments and a lush swpad drift over a brushed LinnDrum groove. This version pulls the drums back and softer with extra room while the sine sub-bass is pushed forward so the low end carries, keeping the loved vocal chops untouched.
code:
setcpm(130/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.72).room(0.2),
    s("hh*4").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.34).swingBy(0.18, 8).cut(1).pan(sine.range(0.35,0.65)),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3] [ab2,c3,eb3]>").s("piano").room(0.5).gain(0.62).lpf(900)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.78).room(0.22),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.38).room(0.42),
    s("hh*4").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.36).swingBy(0.18, 8).cut(1).pan(sine.range(0.35,0.65)),
    note("<c1 c1 ab0 g0>").s("sine").shape(0.32).gain(1.15).lpf(240),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3] [ab2,c3,eb3] [bb2,d3,f3] [g2,bb2,d3]>").s("piano").room(0.5).gain(0.6).lpf(sine.slow(16).range(700,1600))
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.8).room(0.24),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.4).room(0.45),
    s("hh(5,8,2)").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.4).swingBy(0.18, 8).cut(1).pan(sine.range(0.3,0.7)),

    note("<c1 c1 ab0 g0>").s("sine").shape(0.38).gain(1.18).lpf(280),
    s("numbers").chop(8).slice(8, "0 2 4 6 1 3 5 7").speed("<1 1 1.5 0.75>").gain(0.62).room(0.35).delay(0.25).crush(8),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [bb2,d3,f3,ab3] [g2,bb2,d3,f3]>").s("piano").room(0.5).gain(0.6),
    s("swpad").note("<c2 ab1 bb1 g1>").gain(saw.slow(2).range(0.25,0.85)).lpf(1400).room(0.6)
  )],
  [16, stack(
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [bb2,d3,f3,ab3] [g2,bb2,d3,f3]>").s("piano").room(0.7).gain(0.62).lpf(1200).delay(0.3),
    note("<c1 c1 ab0 g0>").s("sine").shape(0.3).gain(1.1).lpf(240),
    s("swpad").note("<c2 ab1 bb1 g1>").gain(saw.slow(2).range(0.3,0.9)).lpf(sine.slow(16).range(800,2200)).room(0.75),
    s("numbers").chop(8).slice(8, "0 ~ 4 ~ ~ 3 ~ 7").speed("<0.75 1 1.5>").gain(0.55).room(0.5).delay(".4:.18:.6").crush(8)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.84).room(0.26),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.42).room(0.45),
    s("hh(5,8,2)").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.42).swingBy(0.2, 8).cut(1).pan(sine.range(0.3,0.7)),
    s("~ ~ oh ~").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.33).cut(1).room(0.3).every(4, x => x.ply(2)),
    note("<c1 c1 ab0 g0>").s("sine").shape(0.42).gain(1.2).lpf(320),
    s("numbers").chop(8).slice(8, "0 2 4 6 1 3 5 7").speed("<1 1.5 0.75 2>").gain(0.6).room(0.4).delay(0.25).crush(8).sometimesBy(0.25, x => x.speed(2)),
    note("<[g3,bb3,d4] [ab3,c4,eb4]>").s("square").attack(0.005).decay(0.12).sustain(0).release(0.08).detune(0.2).gain(0.5).lpf(2200).off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.35)),

  [14, stack(
    s("bd ~ ~ ~").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.6).room(0.3),

    s("swpad").note("<c2 ab1>").gain(saw.slow(2).range(0.2,0.7)).lpf(1000).room(0.85),
    s("numbers").chop(8).slice(8, "0 ~ ~ 4 ~ ~ 7 ~").speed("<0.75 1>").gain(0.45).room(0.6).delay(".5:.2:.7").crush(8)
  )]
)
